template_params.branch_policy: LOCAL WORKSPACE-ONLY MODE (benchmark sandbox): make NO git changes of any kind in the task directory (no git init, branch, commit, push, stash or reset), whether or not it is a git repo; the benchmark harness captures the working tree itself after the run. There is no branch to verify: write git-go-ahead.md stating 'no-git local workspace mode' and continue; do NOT abort because git is absent or because the directory is on a detached or unusual branch. All later stages likewise make no git changes.
